sources.name: World Bank Pink Sheet selected monthly nominal commodity benchmarks1990–September2026
sources.original_data_provider: World Bank Prospects Group compilation; supplied underlying-provider references retained per series

rights.permission_basis: Exact official dataset page declares Public and CC BY4.0 and links the current Commodity Markets website. That site links this exact historical-monthly workbook and its data-use terms. Source metadata/nominal data are distinct from forecast and annual/real-index assets.
rights.third_party_scope: Retain supplied underlying-provider names as compiler provenance. This licence does not grant direct access or rights to proprietary vendor feeds, articles, software or logos. Only the publicly licensed World Bank compilation data and permitted factual metadata are exported.
rights.attribution: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), Prospects Group. CC BY4.0; selected/normalized historical monthly nominal reference observations with source missingness and definitions preserved. No World Bank or underlying-provider endorsement.
use_constraints: Credit source and licence; indicate normalization/selection
Retain original units/definitions/underlying-provider references and uncertainty
No endorsement or proprietary-feed access inferred
Keep actual historical prices separate from forecasts/real indexes/tradable contracts
allowed_fields: Selected native monthly nominal numeric/missing price cells
Exact series headers/native units/current and historical definition metadata
excluded_content: Auxiliary comparison sheet and unrelated worksheet data
Full PDF/report/article bodies, contacts/persons/logos and proprietary raw vendor feeds

sources.source_update_cadence: Provider says second business day monthly; current landing release2026-10-02,next2026-11-03. Timing is publisher-declared, not a tested recurring runtime SLA.
sources.collection_cadence: One bounded workbook/source-PDF acquisition plus deterministic retained replay; daily baseline not configured for this source
sources.series_identity_basis: Derived stable dataset-qualified IDs from frozen source column names; not exchange tickers or upstream API codes

source_method_change_log.text: denotes forecast series
Rubber TSR20 replaces Rubber RSS3 in Other Raw Materials index from 2018
Groundnut oil, replacement series from January 2023

Coal (South Africa), June to November 2022, March, April, June to September, December 2023, and January-May 2024 are estimates based on similar benchmarks, December 2022 to February 2023, May, and October-November 2023 replaced with source data.
Potassium chloride changed from Vancouver to Brazil from January 2020; Groundnut oil corrected for February 2023.
Chicken changed from U.S.A to Brazil from September 2021.
Coffee (Arabica), Cotton, Kolkata tea, and Metal updated for February 2024.
Beef, replacement series from January 2024
Lamb, replacement series from January 2020
Some oilseed November prices have updated entries while December are World Bank estimates. Some oilseed series have been replaced.
January Kolkata corrected. Some oilseed January prices have updated entries while February are World Bank estimates. Some oilseed series have been replaced from January.
Some oilseed February prices have updated entries while some March prices are World Bank estimates.
Several oilseed series have been updated for the period April-November 2025.
Peanut (Groundnut) series updated for the period November 2024-July 2025.
Tobacco series updated for the period July-October 2025.
January 2026: Kolkata and average tea have been updated for November.
February 2026: LNG (Japan) corrected for 2024 (year) and the October-December 2024 (quarterly).
February 2026 edition onwards: Tobacco series are updated for the last three months, with the two most recent months reflecting estimates.
March 2026: Wheat (US SRW) and Phosphate rock corrected for 2023 and 2024.
April 2026: Tea updated for February 2026.
July 2026: Tea updated for June 2026.
August 2026: Replacement series for Fishmeal from July 2026.

September 2026: Some minor inconsistencies in grain prices shown in the August release were the result of formatting issues and have since been addressed. Periods where data are unavailable are indicated by ".."
October 2026: Replacement series for Palm oil from January 2026.
